messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: High error rate on /v1/generate in us-east-1. 5xx spike detected, impact: customer-facing latency and some 503s. Pager sent to #incidents and @mike.oncall

mike.oncall: ack'ing, taking page. jumping in now. grabbing logs + linking grafana.

sara.sre: on call overlap — i'm available for handoff in 10m if needed. what's the current error class? 503s or 504s?

mike.oncall: initial read — mostly 503 gateway errors from inference-proxy, some 429s. latency upstream to runtime nodes looks elevated. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/rt/inference?panel=error-rate (sharing snapshot).

lee.runtime: seeing a surge in open connections to dispatcher-01, queue length jumped. running `kubectl exec` to fetch pod logs. possible cache eviction around 12:32 UTC.

mike.oncall: paste logs below — truncated. ```
E 12:32:11 dispatcher-01: KV cache miss for model:redwood-7b, re-fetching weights
W 12:32:13 dispatcher-01: connection pool Saturation: active=512, max=512
E 12:32:15 proxy-02: upstream timeout while waiting for runtime
```

lee.runtime: hypothesis 1 — sudden model reloading causing resource contention (I/O heavy). hypothesis 2 — a misbehaving batcher causing long-tail delays. starting `strace` and checking disk IO.

anita.csm: we have 2 enterprise customers reporting errors via support ticket — both saw 503s starting ~12:35 UTC. prepping a short status note for them. any ETA on mitigation?

mike.oncall: immediate mitigation: scale up dispatcher and runtime pool by +2 replicas, enable aggressive connection draining on proxy-02, and temporarily route low-priority traffic to fallback-quantized model. Running scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/dispatcher --replicas=6`

incident-bot: action logged — runbook step: scale dispatcher cluster.

lee.runtime: scaled dispatcher and runtime replicas. observing queue length drop after 90s. tailing metrics: tail_latency p50 -> p90 improving. still seeing a small % of 5xx for in-flight requests.

sara.sre: starting timeline notes — adding entries below. please correct if off.

mike.oncall: timeline snippet (rough):
- 12:31 UTC: spike in error rate alerted by SLO monitor (incident-bot page).
- 12:32 UTC: dispatcher-01 queue length increase, KV cache misses logged.
- 12:33 UTC: proxy-02 experiences connection saturation and upstream timeouts.
- 12:35 UTC: mitigation: scale dispatcher + runtime replicas, enable fallback routing.
- 12:36 UTC: enterprise customers report 503s to support.
- 12:38 UTC: error rate begins to decline.

lee.runtime: adding logs that look relevant: ```
I 12:30:58 storage-io: 99th read latency = 320ms
E 12:31:45 weights-loader: I/O error retry attempt 1 for shard-42
W 12:32:09 batcher-03: large batch took 4.2s to process
```

anita.csm: status page draft for customers (short): "We are investigating increased errors for text generation in us-east-1. Some requests may return 503s. Mitigation in progress — we have scaled capacity and expect normal service within ~10-20 minutes. Updates to follow." Thoughts? :speech_balloon:

mike.oncall: fine, please include affected endpoints (/v1/generate) and approximate timeframe. add contact to support line.

sara.sre: taking note for RCA — need these artifacts: grafana panels, dispatcher and proxy logs (12:20-12:45 UTC), kube events, scaling actions, and a diff of any recent deploys. I also want PR/changes in last 24h. tagging @devops-bot to collect logs.

devops-bot: collecting logs for selectors: app=dispatcher OR app=proxy OR app=runtime between 1763003400 and 1763008600. Archive will be available: https://artifacts.redwood/logs/incident-1763005000.tar.gz (ETA 4m).

lee.runtime: quick check — there was a config change to dispatcher batching window 22h ago but nothing deployed in the last 2 hours. storage team mentions a transient high read latency from the blockstore around 12:30 UTC. asking for blockstore metrics.

mike.oncall: can someone own stakeholder comms? i'll keep the incident timeline and mitigation steps. anita, can you post to the customer-facing channel and loop in the account owners for flagged customers?

anita.csm: on it. posting to #customers-incident-updates with the draft. pinging accounts for the two affected enterprise customers.

sara.sre: tracking hypotheses in-thread: H1 = blockstore read latency -> weight load delays -> dispatcher backlog. H2 = batcher regression leading to long tail. H3 = proxy connection pool exhaustion due to a traffic surge or leak. Assigning checks: Lee -> storage I/O and batcher traces, Mike -> proxy metrics and connection pool, Devops-bot -> full logs + kube events.

lee.runtime: running `perf` on batcher-03 and snapshotting heap/threads. also uploading KV cache hit-rate graphs.

mike.oncall: proxy pool patch applied (increase max connections) as a short-term knob, monitoring.

incident-bot: status update — mitigation applied, system-level errors reduced to baseline. Incident state: monitoring.

anita.csm: customer update posted. asked support to flag any regressions.

sara.sre: good. when we wrap, let's sync for an RCA doc. owners: timeline (mike), root cause analysis (lee), mitigation & long-term fixes (sara + devops), customer comms and impact summary (anita). please drop artifacts to the incident folder and I'll stitch the postmortem.

mike.oncall: agreed. I'll export dashboards and link them here once collected.

lee.runtime: preliminary root cause leaning to H1 (blockstore read latencies causing model weight loads which blocked dispatcher). but need full log correlation to be sure.

anita.csm: thanks team — keeping stakeholders updated. next update in 30m or sooner if things change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike.oncall: closing the active pager for now, staying watch.

incident-bot: incident closed to page; monitoring continues. For RCA, please file a postmortem in /incidents/postmortems/ with the tag "prod-us-east-io" and link artifacts.
